description: Agent capability demonstration scenarios — shows agent types across 9 categories with graph-based analysis. Uses Meridian Financial Services (MFS) demo data.

scenarios.title: Trace and Impact Analysis
scenarios.question: Trace PAY-101 to its implementation and assess the blast radius of changing TokenizationService.tokenize_card()
scenarios.expected_output: Path from WorkItem PAY-101 through MR !301 → Commit → File → CodeSymbol, plus dependent entities across payment gateway

scenarios.title: Incident Root Cause Analysis
scenarios.question: What caused INC0080101 (payment timeout spike) and which deployment introduced the regression?
scenarios.expected_output: Incident → affected CI mfs-payment-gateway → recent CHG0090101 → Pipeline 9001 → MR !301 → PAY-101 tokenization change chain

scenarios.title: PCI DSS Compliance Verification
scenarios.question: Verify that all cardholder data handling meets PCI DSS encryption and key management requirements
scenarios.expected_output: Compliance check against PAY-201 encryption at rest, PAY-202 HSM key rotation, token vault architecture, audit trail in mfs_audit_db

scenarios.title: Release Governance Check
scenarios.question: Is the Payment Gateway v2 release ready? Check all test suites, pipeline status, monitoring, and documentation completeness
scenarios.expected_output: Multi-step workflow: TC-PAY-007 IN_PROGRESS and TC-PAY-008 NOT_RUN are blockers; Grafana dashboards configured; Confluence docs present but runbook needs update

scenarios.title: Graph Anomaly Detection
scenarios.question: Find orphan vertices, disconnected components, and suspicious patterns in the MFS enterprise graph
scenarios.expected_output: Anomalies: mfs-customer-portal code entities not linked to any Jira story; settlement engine has no Kibana dashboard; some Figma components not linked to code

scenarios.title: Design-to-Implementation Traceability
scenarios.question: Which Figma designs have been implemented and which are pending for the payment portal?
scenarios.expected_output: PaymentCard → PaymentForm.tsx (implemented), CurrencySelector → (no code link yet), SettlementTable → (partially implemented)

scenarios.title: Knowledge Provenance Audit
scenarios.question: How was the payment gateway architecture documentation created and when was it last verified?
scenarios.expected_output: Confluence page created by Sarah Chen on 2026-08-15, last edited 2026-09-28, linked to 3 code repos, 2 API specs, not verified since PAY-103 multicurrency addition

scenarios.title: Change Blast Radius Assessment
scenarios.question: What is the blast radius of upgrading sqlalchemy in mfs-common-libs?
scenarios.expected_output: Affects mfs-payment-gateway (DBClient), mfs-fraud-engine (model storage), mfs-settlement-engine; 4 pipelines, 2 ServiceNow changes needed, 12 test cases to re-run

scenarios.title: Cross-Domain Peer Review
scenarios.question: Review the fraud engine's interaction with the payment gateway — are there circular dependencies or missing error handlers?
scenarios.expected_output: FraudAPI calls PaymentAPI for transaction data; no circular dependency found; missing error handler in FraudScorer when payment service is unavailable
